instruction.name: xvshuf4i.d
instruction.description: For each 128-bit lane, select two 64-bit elements from the four elements formed by the corresponding lanes of `a` and `b` using `imm[1:0]` and `imm[3:2]`, save the result to `dst`.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 1.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvshuf4i.d $xr0, $xr8, 1; xvshuf4i.d $xr1, $xr9, 1; xvshuf4i.d $xr2, $xr10, 1; xvshuf4i.d $xr3, $xr11, 1; xvshuf4i.d $xr4, $xr12, 1; xvshuf4i.d $xr5, $xr13, 1; xvshuf4i.d $xr6, $xr14, 1; xvshuf4i.d $xr7, $xr15, 1
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr15, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr15, $r4' --asm 'xvshuf4i.d $xr0, $xr8, 1; xvshuf4i.d $xr1, $xr9, 1; xvshuf4i.d $xr2, $xr10, 1; xvshuf4i.d $xr3, $xr11, 1; xvshuf4i.d $xr4, $xr12, 1; xvshuf4i.d $xr5, $xr13, 1; xvshuf4i.d $xr6, $xr14, 1; xvshuf4i.d $xr7, $xr15, 1'

notes: Latency values are reported as whole cycles; earlier two-decimal values and +/-0.1 bands were rounding artifacts of the measurement pipeline.
